summary: Full production deployment of DRIFT, a Node.js WebSocket multiplayer game from a GitHub repo. Dockerized with two containers (server + nginx static/proxy), wired behind host nginx with TLS, and set up with systemd for auto-start on reboot.
highlights: Cloned MAX-786/DRIFT repo and built multi-stage Dockerfiles for server (Node.js TS) and client (Vite SPA via nginx)
docker-compose stack: drift-server on internal port 3001, drift-client on 127.0.0.1:8765 only, isolated on drift-net bridge network
Host nginx config written for drift.mkhismkh.com with TLS termination (self-signed cert for Cloudflare Full mode) and /ws proxy for WebSocket upgrade
systemd drift.service enabled — containers auto-start on reboot
Verified stack end-to-end: both containers healthy, static site serving, WS endpoint returning correct 426 upgrade response
